"""MIT. Open the source-monitoring workflow in the original NDJSON workspace."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import sys
import threading

from model import Workspace, InputError, json_bytes
from web import OperatorServer
import matching
import updates
import review_cycles
import gleif_portfolio
import portfolio_refresh

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, help="Original private NDJSON workspace")
    p.add_argument("--create", action="store_true", help="Create the original workspace once")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    server = sub.add_parser("serve"); server.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0)
    server.add_argument("--connection-file", help="Create the original private one-line console connection")
    server.add_argument("--expected-binding", help="Require the reviewed native workspace, Python and source")
    server.add_argument("--startup-format", choices=["legacy", "json"], default="legacy")
    sub.add_parser("binding", help="Inspect native application identity without opening the workspace writer")
    sub.add_parser("state")
    source = sub.add_parser("receive-published"); source.add_argument("--metadata-url", required=True)
    edition = sub.add_parser("receive-edition")
    edition.add_argument("--metadata", required=True); edition.add_argument("--entities", required=True)
    edition.add_argument("--metadata-url", required=True)
    compare = sub.add_parser("compare"); compare.add_argument("--before", required=True); compare.add_argument("--after", required=True)
    change = sub.add_parser("receive-update"); change.add_argument("--before", required=True); change.add_argument("--after", required=True)
    export = sub.add_parser("export"); export.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    receive = sub.add_parser("import"); receive.add_argument("--input", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("cycles", help="List finite customer review cycles")
    cycle = sub.add_parser("cycle"); cycle.add_argument("--id", required=True)
    command = sub.add_parser("cycle-command"); command.add_argument("--input", required=True)
    report = sub.add_parser("cycle-report"); report.add_argument("--id", required=True)
    report.add_argument("--version", required=True, type=int); report.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    report.add_argument("--html", action="store_true")
    gleif_preview = sub.add_parser("gleif-preview", help="Inspect a complete GLEIF research handover; no matching")
    gleif_preview.add_argument("--input", required=True)
    gleif_preview.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0)
    gleif_preview.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=50)
    gleif_receive = sub.add_parser("gleif-receive", help="Receive an explicitly reviewed original handover request")
    gleif_receive.add_argument("--request", required=True)
    gleif_status = sub.add_parser("gleif-intake", help="Reconcile the original intake request")
    gleif_status.add_argument("--request-id", required=True)
    refresh_prepare = sub.add_parser("portfolio-refresh-prepare", help="Compare two original customer portfolio editions")
    refresh_prepare.add_argument("--before", required=True); refresh_prepare.add_argument("--after", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("portfolio-refreshes")
    refresh_view = sub.add_parser("portfolio-refresh")
    refresh_view.add_argument("--id", required=True)
    refresh_view.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0); refresh_view.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=50)
    refresh_view.add_argument("--kind"); refresh_view.add_argument("--query", default="")
    refresh_command = sub.add_parser("portfolio-refresh-command")
    refresh_command.add_argument("--request", required=True)
    refresh_request = sub.add_parser("portfolio-refresh-request"); refresh_request.add_argument("--request-id", required=True)
    refresh_report = sub.add_parser("portfolio-refresh-report")
    refresh_report.add_argument("--id", required=True); refresh_report.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    refresh_report.add_argument("--html", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if args.action == "binding":
        from application_binding import inspect_binding
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(json_bytes(inspect_binding(args.workspace)))
        return
    binding = None
    if args.action == "serve" and (args.expected_binding is not None or args.startup_format == "json"):
        from application_binding import require_binding
        binding = require_binding(args.workspace, args.expected_binding)
    with Workspace(args.workspace, create=args.create) as ws:
        if binding is not None:
            binding = require_binding(str(ws.root), binding["sha256"])
        d = ws.opensanctions
        if args.action == "serve":
            if not 0 <= args.port <= 65535:
                raise InputError("Port must be from 0 to 65535")
            app = OperatorServer(ws, args.port)
            stop = lambda *_: threading.Thread(target=app.shutdown, daemon=True).start()
            previous = {sig: signal.signal(sig, stop) for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM)}
            try:
                if binding is not None or args.connection_file:
                    from application_binding import published_connection, startup
                    connection = published_connection(args.connection_file, app.url)
                else:
                    from contextlib import nullcontext
                    connection = nullcontext(None)
                with connection as connection_file:
                    if binding is not None:
                        app.launch = startup(app, binding, connection_file)
                    announcement = app.launch if args.startup_format == "json" else {
                        "url": app.url, "workspace": str(ws.root),
                        "schema": "starforge.opensanctions-console.v1",
                        **({"connectionFile": connection_file} if connection_file else {}),
                    }
                    print(json.dumps(announcement, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
                    app.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.2)
            finally:
                app.launch = None
                app.server_close()
                for sig, handler in previous.items():
                    signal.signal(sig, handler)
            return
        matching.recover_interrupted(d)
        if args.action == "portfolio-refresh-prepare":
            result = portfolio_refresh.prepare(d, args.before, args.after)
        elif args.action == "portfolio-refreshes":
            result = portfolio_refresh.view(d)
        elif args.action == "portfolio-refresh":
            result = portfolio_refresh.view(d, args.id, offset=args.offset, limit=args.limit, kind=args.kind, query=args.query)
        elif args.action == "portfolio-refresh-command":
            from model import load_json
            result = portfolio_refresh.command(d, load_json(Path(args.request).read_bytes()))
        elif args.action == "portfolio-refresh-request":
            result = portfolio_refresh.operation(d, args.request_id)
        elif args.action == "portfolio-refresh-report":
            from model import private_write
            result = portfolio_refresh.report(d, args.id)
            content = portfolio_refresh.report_html(d, args.id).encode() if args.html else json_bytes(result)
            output = Path(args.output)
            if output.exists():
                if output.read_bytes() != content:
                    raise InputError("The selected report snapshot output already contains different bytes; choose a new output")
            else:
                private_write(output, content)
            result = {"comparisonId": args.id, "file": str(output), "bytes": len(content),
                      "sha256": __import__("hashlib").sha256(content).hexdigest()}
        elif args.action == "gleif-preview":
            with Path(args.input).open("rb") as stream:
                original = d.put_object(stream, Path(args.input).name, "application/json")
            result = gleif_portfolio.preview(d, original["id"], offset=args.offset, limit=args.limit)
        elif args.action == "gleif-receive":
            from model import load_json
            result = gleif_portfolio.receive(d, load_json(Path(args.request).read_bytes()))
        elif args.action == "gleif-intake":
            result = gleif_portfolio.operation(d, args.request_id)
        elif args.action == "cycles":
            result = review_cycles.view(d)
        elif args.action == "cycle":
            result = review_cycles.view(d, args.id)
        elif args.action == "cycle-command":
            from model import load_json
            result = review_cycles.command(d, load_json(Path(args.input).read_bytes()))
        elif args.action == "cycle-report":
            from model import private_write
            result = review_cycles.report(d, args.id, args.version)
            content = review_cycles.report_html(d, args.id, args.version).encode() if args.html else json_bytes(result)
            output = Path(args.output)
            if output.exists():
                if output.read_bytes() != content:
                    raise InputError("The selected report output already contains different bytes")
            else:
                private_write(output, content)
            result = {"cycleId": args.id, "version": args.version, "file": str(output), "bytes": len(content), "sha256": __import__("hashlib").sha256(content).hexdigest()}
        elif args.action == "state":
            result = d.state()
        elif args.action == "receive-published":
            result = updates.receive_published(d, args.metadata_url)
        elif args.action == "receive-edition":
            with Path(args.metadata).open("rb") as meta, Path(args.entities).open("rb") as entities:
                result = d.accept_edition(meta, entities, metadata_url=args.metadata_url)
        elif args.action == "compare":
            result = d.compare(args.before, args.after)
        elif args.action == "receive-update":
            result = updates.fetch_update(d, args.before, args.after)
        elif args.action == "export":
            result = d.export_packet(Path(args.output))
        else:
            result = d.import_packet(Path(args.input))
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(json_bytes(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (InputError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": str(error)}), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)

"""MIT. OpenSanctions application identity over the original NDJSON binding."""
from __future__ import annotations
import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path

from model import NDJSON, SCHEMA as DOMAIN_SCHEMA, InputError, json_bytes
import managed as original_managed

if Path(original_managed.__file__).resolve() != NDJSON / "managed.py":
    raise InputError("The original NDJSON managed identity module was not selected")

BINDING = "stellar-forge.opensanctions-managed-binding.v1"
STARTUP = "stellar-forge.opensanctions-workspace-launch.v1"
SOURCE_FILES = (
    "model.py", "gleif_portfolio.py", "portfolio_refresh.py", "updates.py", "matching.py", "review_cycles.py", "web.py", "cli.py",
    "application_binding.py", "cli.mjs", "managed.mjs", "application-provider.mjs",
    "public/index.html", "public/app.js", "public/gleif-intake.js", "public/portfolio-refresh.js", "public/review-cycles.js", "public/style.css", "SOURCE_CONTRACT.json",
)

# Reuse the native private connection-file context, including its exact-file
# cleanup. Its CLI is imported under a distinct name and its main is never run.
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_opensanctions_original_ndjson_cli", NDJSON / "cli.py")
original_cli = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(original_cli)
published_connection = original_cli.published_connection


def inspect_binding(directory):
    """Inspect the existing native identity without opening its SQLite writer."""
    native = original_managed.inspect_binding(directory)
    source = dict(native["source"])
    for name in SOURCE_FILES:
        source["ndjson/opensanctions/" + name] = original_managed.source_digest(
            NDJSON / "opensanctions" / name)
    value = {
        key: item for key, item in native.items() if key != "sha256"
    } | {
        "schema": BINDING, "domainSchema": DOMAIN_SCHEMA,
        "nativeBindingSha256": native["sha256"], "source": source,
    }
    bound = {key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != "sourceRoot"}
    return value | {"sha256": original_managed.digest(json_bytes(bound))}


def require_binding(directory, expected):
    value = inspect_binding(directory)
    if expected is not None and (
            not isinstance(expected, str) or len(expected) != 64
            or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in expected)
            or value["sha256"] != expected):
        raise InputError("The selected source-monitoring workspace, Python or source changed; review the original application again")
    return value


def startup(server, binding, connection_file=None):
    return {
        "schema": STARTUP, "status": "OPENSANCTIONS_WORKSPACE_READY",
        "domainSchema": DOMAIN_SCHEMA,
        "workspace": binding["workspace"], "bindingSha256": binding["sha256"],
        "nativeBindingSha256": binding["nativeBindingSha256"],
        "sourceRoot": binding["sourceRoot"], "python": binding["python"],
        "pid": os.getpid(), "console": server.url,
        **({"connectionFile": connection_file} if connection_file is not None else {}),
    }

# Customer portfolio edition refresh

This is the original Source Monitoring workspace's explicit customer-data update workflow. It compares two complete retained portfolios with the same customer key, preserves every original FtM entity, and lets a named reviewer retain or continue an existing case. It does not dispatch a provider request, decide that an entity is sanctioned, buy data, or automatically close a case.

## Use the original application

Open **Portfolio refresh** in the existing Monitoring navigation. Choose the earlier and following customer portfolios. The whole population is compared using the original FtM comparison implementation: added, removed, changed and unchanged counterparts, exact property values, value-order changes, other original fields and source record positions. Search and change filters affect the visible page only; both reports contain the complete population.

Open **Inspect and review** for a counterparty. Read either original entity, exact changed attributes and every original case. Case identity and relevance remain separate. The screen distinguishes cases still on the earlier portfolio, already continued cases, and cases on another retained edition.

Choose one explicit course:
- **Retain** records a named review against the exact earlier case revision and leaves that case unchanged.
- **Continue** revises the same original case against the following portfolio. Choose identity and relevance explicitly and supply reviewer/reason. The case's native source edition, candidate and monitoring profile remain retained.
- **Source only** records an attributed source review without marking or changing any case.

An absent following counterparty cannot be continued. Removal does not retire a case. A case on another portfolio is not silently rebased. The original case remains available through **Open original case**. Existing finite review cycles retain their original populations and historical case revisions; this workflow does not rewrite them.

A previous native match response belongs to its original portfolio. Continuation does not carry that response as evidence about the following portfolio. An optional replacement must be an actual retained RECEIVED response for the following portfolio and selected candidate. No provider dispatch occurs here.

## Recovery and competing edits

Before sending, the browser persists the original request ID and complete choices in its existing workspace-scoped local storage. **Continue original review** resends those exact choices. **Read original request status** reconciles an already committed result. A missing result alone does not discard an uncertain request.

A definitive rejection leaves an attributed local request history and allows a newly reviewed request. An uncertain network response retains the original pending request. Changed choices under a reused request ID are rejected. Native case revision checks reject a stale edit. A successful case revision and refresh receipt commit in one original SQLite transaction; neither can be committed alone.

The complete original case predecessor chain is verified with the maintained review-cycle verifier, including revision hashes, previous links, stable identity and chronology. Later legitimate case edits leave the captured review valid and the UI labels it historical. Comparison receipt replay precedes any new case timestamp or revision generation.

## Full export and independent reopen

The original workspace exporter includes both additive tables, all prior case events, original builds, source bytes and object attachments. It validates comparison and review history before export. Original import validates the same history inside its existing acceptance transaction. Older archives without refresh tables remain accepted with empty additive collections.

The immutable comparison retains both original source descriptors, including the author's labels and timestamps. Native cold import may assign local source labels/times; receiving validates stable source ID, byte count and inventory while reports retain the captured originals.

Reports are complete snapshots of the immutable comparison and current original case observations, not a new report-edition registry. JSON includes its source snapshot SHA; HTML includes all source descriptors, changed attributes, attributed events and cases. Later case edits may create a different report snapshot. Existing CLI output with different bytes is protected; select a new output path.
